composite_candidates.name: authorize_then_capture_charge
composite_candidates.rationale: Two-step settlement pattern: create Charge with capture=false, then capture later. Common merchant flow when shipping confirmation gates settlement.

tool_plans.name: stripe_search
tool_plans.rationale: Cross-resource search across customers, charges, subscriptions returning ranked smart IDs.

tool_plans.name: stripe_fetch
tool_plans.rationale: Retrieve a single Stripe object by smart ID; routes to /retrieve endpoint per type.

tool_plans.name: collections_list
tool_plans.rationale: List available top-level Stripe object collections for discovery.

tool_plans.name: objects_list
tool_plans.rationale: List Stripe objects within a chosen collection with cursor pagination and filtering.

tool_plans.name: objects_upsert
tool_plans.rationale: Create or update a Stripe object (smart routing by presence of id; supports idempotency_key).

tool_plans.name: objects_delete
tool_plans.rationale: Delete a Stripe Customer or Subscription (Charge cannot be deleted; use charges_refund).

tool_plans.name: charges_capture
tool_plans.rationale: Capture funds previously authorized on an uncaptured Charge (does not fit upsert — distinct side-effect on settle state).

tool_plans.name: charges_refund
tool_plans.rationale: Refund a captured Charge (destructive, !idempotent per _refund verb pattern).

tool_plans.name: subscriptions_cancel
tool_plans.rationale: Cancel an active Subscription (destructive+idempotent per _cancel verb pattern; preserves audit trail vs delete).
